messages.content: How did Dorothy and the buggy move along the river before the others joined her?
They floated downstream with the current.
What did the Wizard take out to treat Jim’s cuts when they caught up?
Sticking-plaster.
Why did the children light a lantern before going down from the platform in the Gargoyles’ house?
To show them the way.
What did they find on the floors below?
Several stories of empty rooms.
Why did the Wizard say the Gargoyles chose a time during the day to rest?
There was no night in their country.
Who yawned and said he was sleepy right afterward?
Zeb.
What did Jim say shows where he has been cut?
The blood that runs out.
What did the Sawhorse say it felt when it got a splinter?
It felt nothing.
Who did the Wizard tell the piglets to ask if he was a humbug?
Dorothy.
What did she say he needed to perform his tricks?
His tools and machinery.
What did the Woggle-Bug say he did not like Dorothy to upset during the trial?
His thoughts.
What did the Scarecrow say about good thoughts?
They would not become confused.
